key_facts: Target 0x00000000000044a361Ae3cAc094c9D1b14Eece97 (Ethereum), 10,474-byte runtime, NOT a proxy (EIP-1967 slots zero), verified UniswapV4Router04 solc 0.8.26 runs 9999999 viaIR cancun, deployed block 22,281,170

swap(bytes,uint256) 0xaf2b4aba gates the payer with `calldataload(164) == caller()`; runtime byte offset 0x59a is PUSH1 0xa4 / CALLDATALOAD / SUB vs CALLER, reverting at 0x5b2 with PUSH4 0x82b42900 (Unauthorized)

ABI decoder for the bytes argument validates only bounds (offset<=2^64-1, offset+32+len<=calldatasize), never canonicality -> offset 0xc0 decouples the gate word (164) from the decoded BaseData.payer (292)
Exhaustive Approval(_,router) scan from deployment to block 26,253,889: 4,256 logs, 3,284 distinct (token,owner), 623 owners, 933 tokens, 0 ERC721/ERC6909; 26 pairs have allowance>0 AND balance>0
Nominal drainable (sum of min(allowance,balance) priced) = $14.40; actually reachable = $2.60
Scope-scan reachable dust: DFYT $0.0256, OMPALOMPA $0.0012, PNKSTR $0.0002, MOONSTR $0.00004, Lottery/TST/PNKSTRs/NINTONDO < $0.00001
Attacker cost is gas only (~$0.05 per leg at 0.1286 gwei); no capital, no flash loan, no privileges; all legs can be batched via the router's public multicall(bytes[])

Identical runtime code live at the same address on Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Unichain (auth pattern at byte 1433, Unauthorized at byte 282; only immutables differ); 0 drainable approvals on those chains

Same bug publicly documented by DARKNAVY (2026-03-03, block 24,575,085): 42,606.96 USDC (~21.198 ETH) drained from 0x65a8f07bd9a8598e1b5b6c0a88f4779dbc077675 via the ETH/USDC v4 pool, output to 0xd6b7e831d64e573278f091aa7e68fbf2a8fa9916
caveats: Headline is the fork-verified residual, not the $14.40 nominal drainable; $11.80 is blocked by verified token-level behaviour (USDT no-bool $4.99, SPUNK NotValidRouter $3.54, TEST zero-liquidity $3.16, DEPHI/WOWSTR $0.17, uPEG hook $0)
Micro-cap USD prices (PNZI, FR, OMPALOMPA, ...) are indicative (+/-50%); token amounts are exact on-chain reads and the ETH outputs are exact fork measurements
Fork tests run at the head block of the run (public fork RPCs are non-archive); pinned-block state was read separately at 26,253,889 via eth_call
Error selector 0x2f352531 (WOWSTR/DEPHI transferFrom) could not be matched to a public error name
Permit2 allowances are excluded from the universe (require a victim signature, unusable by an unprivileged attacker); no ERC-6909 approvals exist for this router
Extractable figures are gross of gas; net at the observed 0.1286 gwei is ~$2.47 and the residual is sub-gas above roughly 6-12 gwei
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$2.60 live from UniswapV4Router04 on Ethereum via the hardcoded calldataload(164) auth bypass (fork-proven $2.34 from one PNZI victim), gas-only cost ~$0.10; the $14.40 nominal drainable is mostly unreachable because USDT returns no bool (router settle reverts), SPUNK/WOWSTR/DEPHI tokens blacklist the router, and TEST has no pool liquidity - but the bug is live, unpatched and re-arms with any new approval.
